From: Elena Ruiz <procurement@clearlynx.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@clearlynx.io (Tom Baker)
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding submission — ClearLynx

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro. Attaching our completed onboarding packet and the initial line-item breakdown (CSV). A couple of notes we want to surface so procurement can create the PO and set the proper spend cap:

- Our sales contact submitted an initial request with a provisional cap of $75,000, but expected first-month spend (migration + premium support) is closer to $95,000. We anticipate steady monthly spend around $30k thereafter.
- One SKU in the intake form ("data-ingest-1TB") was mapped to an internal Redwood SKU that looks like it caused a line-item mismatch on your portal. We've included an updated CSV (clearlynx_lineitems_v2.csv).
- We need a provisional PO in place by Dec 10 to avoid delaying the migration.

Attachments: ClearLynx_onboarding_form.pdf, clearlynx_lineitems_v2.csv

Can you confirm next steps and who on your side will issue the PO?

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement
ClearLynx Analytics
procurement@clearlynx.io

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <procurement@clearlynx.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding submission — ClearLynx

Elena —

Appreciate the packet and the corrected CSV. Quick read-through and a path forward below:

1) Line-item correction: Connor (procurement ops) will ingest the updated CSV and align the SKU mapping. Connor — can you confirm the SKU normalization ETA? Prefer within 24 business hours.

2) Spend cap: Current system shows a provisional cap at $75,000. To issue a PO for the first month we need either an approved spend-cap increase or a one-time provisional PO for $100k–$125k that we can reconcile against actuals. Please confirm whether ClearLynx is comfortable with a provisional PO at $120,000 (covers migration variance). If you can provide a short SOW or the migration estimate we can formalize that number.

3) PO timing: If SKU mapping is corrected and procurement signs off on the cap increase, we can generate a provisional PO within 48 hours. If not, we can issue a partial PO for the confirmed recurring items and then a supplemental PO for migration.

Related links: https://redwood.app/hubspot/deal/CLX-3892

Action items:
- Elena: confirm provisional cap (recommended $120k) and attach SOW if available
- Connor: ingest CSV and return normalized line items
- Monica: please review any billing-code constraints for this vendor (we may need a billing-code override)

Thanks — trying to keep this moving to meet your Dec 10 target.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Karthik / Monica —

Forwarding the thread above. ClearLynx has provided the corrected line items and a signed W9; they are asking for a provisional PO by Dec 10 to avoid pushing their migration (see SOW attached in their reply).

Summary:
- Requested provisional PO: $120,000 (covers migration variance; first-month expected ~$95k)
- Corrected attachment: clearlynx_lineitems_v2.csv (SKU mapping fixed)
- Billing: may require billing-code override — Monica, can you confirm whether we can map this under the vendor-subscriptions cost center or if we should route to the integration projects code?

Ask: Approve a one-time spend-cap exception to $125k (gives a small buffer) and authorize procurement ops to generate the provisional PO against deal CLX-3892. If approved I will instruct Connor to push the normalized line items into the PO system and generate the PO PDF for signature.

Deadline: we need approval by EOD Dec 8 to meet ClearLynx's Dec 10 provisioning goal.
